name: Commerce Tabby
description: Tabby Payments (BNPL) gateway for Drupal Commerce. The webhook (onNotify) re-fetches the payment from Tabby's API server-side (GET v2/payments/{id}) and derives status from the authenticated API response, not the notification body.
project_description:
Commerce Tabby module implements the Tabby payment processing service (Tabby) in Drupal Commerce.

 Installtion instructions: 
 * You can install this module via Composer (recommended), or

* clone it from drupal.org Git repo, or

* Download the module from drupal.org

 This module is developed & sponsored by Coders Enterprise Web & Mobile Solutions
